plan.summary: This 4-week block is a simple off-camp boxing S&C build for a beginner with one weekly session and higher sparring emphasis. Week 1 establishes bodyweight performance baselines that will guide progression, then Weeks 2-4 build general lower-body and upper-body strength, trunk strength, and explosive intent without adding unnecessary fatigue to boxing work. The full 12-week parent cycle keeps building through Week 8, then shifts toward sharper power and speed expression in Weeks 9-12.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish simple bodyweight baselines, then build general strength, trunk stiffness, and explosive intent with low-equipment work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the hardest bodyweight variations and raise force output while keeping weekly fatigue easy to recover from around sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength with lower volume and express it faster through crisp jumps, push-up speed, and sharper full-body power.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can on every rep. Reset between reps and land softly with control.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if repeated landing mechanics are easier to control from a paused start.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low stable box if landing on the floor bothers your joints.

exercises.name: 1b. Plyometric Push-Up
exercises.notes: Explode up fast. If you cannot leave the floor cleanly, perform speed push-ups with maximal intent.

substitutionOptions.name: Speed Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Drive up as fast as possible while keeping body line tight.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Speed Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench or box if full-floor reps are not crisp.

exercises.name: 2. Push-Up
exercises.notes: This is your baseline test for future progression. Use strict form, chest to floor depth, and stop before the next clean rep would fail.

strengthAssessment.prompt: After a few easy warm-up sets, perform one all-out strict set while stopping with about 1 rep left in reserve. Log the reps completed cleanly so the app can use this as your starting baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Beat your clean rep total over time without losing body position.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if full push-ups are not yet clean for repeated reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if incline options are unavailable and you need a simpler baseline.

exercises.name: 3. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a slow lower and full range. Keep front foot flat and torso tall.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if split squat balance is limiting the work too much.

substitutionOptions.name: Bodyweight Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if knee comfort is better with a bilateral pattern.

exercises.name: 4. Inverted Row Under Sturdy Table or Bar
exercises.notes: Pull chest toward the edge, keep body straight, and stop 1-2 reps before form breaks.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorframe Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a very secure setup and keep the angle conservative.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: If no safe rowing setup exists, pull hard into an immovable object for 15-20 seconds per effort.

exercises.name: 5. Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Drive through the heel and pause at the top for a full second without arching your low back.

substitutionOptions.name: Two-Leg Glute Bridge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if single-leg control is not yet solid.

substitutionOptions.name: Hamstring Walkout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you want a slightly harder posterior-chain option.

exercises.name: 6. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Keep lower back pressed down and ribs tucked. Shorten the lever if you lose position.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you cannot hold the hollow position without your back lifting.

substitutionOptions.name: Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor space or comfort makes hollow holds awkward.

exercises.name: 7. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Stay long from head to heel and keep hips stacked.

substitutionOptions.name: Bent-Knee Side Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the full version is too demanding.
